values: AmazonBasics Handle Sets are made from Zinc Alloy and hand finished to ensure a uniform look amongst all styles and hardware sets.

AmazonBasics cabinet pulls are made from durable zinc-alloy and are hand finished to ensure a uniform look amongst all styles and hardware sets. Backed with a 1-Year warranty, AmazonBasics cabinet pulls are ideal for redesigning any kitchen, bath, home or office. An Amazon Brand.

AmazonBasics offers everyday items for your home, office, garden and more. With a selection that continues to grow, the AmazonBasics brand is set to become a part of your daily convenience for electronics products and lifestyle.

AmazonBasics On-Ear Headphones Combining high-quality audio with compact portability, the AmazonBasics on-ear headphones make it easy to enjoy all your favorite digital content--from playlists to podcasts--while at home (without disturbing others) or on the go, bringing a little more fun to that long line, waiting room, or daily work commute. A standard 3.5mm jack (with a 90-degree angle) effortlessly connects the corded headphones to an Apple iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, or other music-player device. Inline Microphone and Remote -One click: start/stop music or answer/end calls -Two clicks: skip to next song -Three clicks: play previous song
